meta.scene: The milonga falls silent. They are both here.
He crosses the floor. She does not look up.
The bandoneon plays her song. She stands.
Step for step, neither will lead, neither will follow.
The band plays faster. So do they.
The circle of fifths: for eight bars, they remember why they loved this.
The whole room has stopped to watch.
A final dip. A grudging smile. Applause.
